children: gained in early investor reaction to the company's second-quarter earnings report.

The California-based company reported revenues increased 2.6% to $922.2M during the quarter, topping the consensus estimate by $5.9M. Adjusted EBITDA of $178.5M, inclusive of $55.1M of tariff benefit. RH

noted that it expects to recognize an additional $13.9M tariff benefit in the second half of the year, which it plans to use to offset $50M of unplanned cost increases across its supply chain due to the "significant and sustained spike" in oil prices as a result of the continued conflict in the Middle East.
expects Q3 revenue growth of 5.0% to 6.0% and full-year revenue growth of 5.5% to 7.0%. RH
sees adjusted capital expenditures decreasing from $240M to $260M in 2026 to $175M to $200M in 2027. RH

said its new real estate strategy includes RH Compound, a multi-building shopping experience with connecting garden courtyards and a central atrium restaurant under construction in Naples, Florida, scheduled to open at the end of 2026 or beginning of 2027. Another RH Compound is expected to begin construction soon in Aventura, Florida, and open in 2027.
rose 8.2% in postmarket trading to $145.00 vs. the 52-week range of $106.30 to $248.44. Short interest in RH
stands at 26.3% of the total float.
